De acordo com relatórios publicados pela NASA News, os novos dados confirmam: Like a spectral form rising out of a cold mist, NASA’s Hubble and James Webb Space Telescopes have captured a hauntingly dynamic star-forming scene. It lies within the vast Carina Nebula, a diffuse star-forming region located about 7,500 light-years away from Earth. The small, select area both telescopes observed is nicknamed the Cat’s Head Nebula […]. Isso muda completamente o cenário porque abre portas para aplicações que antes pareciam distantes.
